editorial:
Imagine landing a spot at a top-tier medical school, only to find a guy you just met on a train lying on your dissection table. That is exactly what happens to Paula, and it sets off a creepy chain of events. You get the feeling right away that something is off in this school. The movie mixes a cold, sterile hospital environment with a dark mystery that keeps you guessing. You will feel Paula's confusion and fear as she tries to figure out why this man died and who is trying to hide the truth from her.

The acting is solid, and the way the mystery unfolds keeps the story moving well, though it starts a bit slow. You might find some of the medical scenes a bit gross, but that is part of the thrill. If you love puzzles and spooky settings, you should definitely give this a shot. Since it is an older film, you might want to look for a high-quality digital version.
endingExplained: You find out that the school is part of a dark plot involving organ harvesting and illegal experiments. The man Paula met was a victim of these crimes. In the end, Paula discovers that the people she trusted as teachers are actually killers. After a tense showdown, the truth comes out about the medical conspiracy, but it leaves you feeling that the system is corrupted and dangerous for anyone who asks too many questions.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves medical mysteries and psychological thrills.
